title: Palm Hill Ukulele Group
summary: The Palm Hill Ukulele Group will meet this Wednesday, August 12th, at 3:00 P.M. in the South's clubhouse. Bring your ukulele, voice, or just come to enjoy the music.
public_detail: Good day all you Palm Hillers! We just want to let you know that the Palm Hill Ukulele Group will be meeting this Wednesday August 12th. in the South's clubhouse at 3:00 P.M. for some strummin and funnin! You're more than welcome to come on down and join in with them! Bring your ukulele, your voice, a friend or just sit for a while and enjoy the music. Take care and see y'all then!
